status: experimental: 0.3.0 with stronger bit crusher presets and stock Grid FX colours; hardware untested
reason: Crusher bit param is 0-127 (index value/2 into X:$4400); presets were 3-10. FX row colours from palette 0x08062AB0 [0x39/0x40 + type].
boot_failure_cause: D2 fails and D3 boots with the single heap-limit store disabled. The heap-limit reduction is the failing executable change in that reported hardware pair; the precise faulting allocation was not captured.
recovery_result: User confirmed official firmware restored successfully; blank project saved; instrument is in bootloader mode.

d3_hardware_result.single_instruction_change_from_d2: Heap-limit store at 0x0806B024 replaced with NOP

v014_hardware_result.fm_audio: User reports no sound from tracks 1 and 2 in Note mode.

v015_hardware_result.fm_audio: User reports silence, with occasional clicks when pressing note pads.

v016_hardware_result.fm_audio: User reports an initial sharp/plucky attack followed by sustain, heavily degraded with background crackling.

v017_hardware_result.note: Transfer page opened for the user; no boot, audio or runtime status reported before 0.1.8 was built.

requested_changes: focus on dark ambient and rhythmic noise
distortion and sample-track filter knobs on FM tracks
next note must not cut the current note

v019_hardware_result.user_report: Distortion and filter sections work as they should. A second note played while the previous one is still sustained or releasing degrades the audio: crackle, stutter, decimation/bitcrusher-like sound.

v0110_hardware_result.user_report: Behaving a lot better; occasional cutoffs (a note sustains then ends abruptly when the next is played) and occasional clicks.
v0110_hardware_result.interpretation: Cutoffs = overload guard retiring long ambient release tails; clicks = underruns; DWT counter not running.

v0111_hardware_result.note: User moved on to the drum request without a 0.1.11 report.

v0112_hardware_result.user_report: It works, but there is significant crackling.

d0113_hardware_result.user_report: The issue is still there (crackling). Tempo far too slow at 137 BPM, 1:1 clock division.

d0114_hardware_result.user_report: The FM drum tracks now sound fantastic (no log; crackle/tempo not reported).

d0116_hardware_result.user_report: Per-step locks work as expected with Record engaged. Macros 1-4 control nothing on the FM tracks. Hold step + Shift + knob changes no mixer parameter and registers nothing; pressing Shift while holding a step turns the Record LED from red to green (stock Shift layer).

d0117_hardware_result.user_report: Locks on macros 1 (delay send) and 2 (reverb send) work well. Locks on macros 3 and 4 (level, pan) do nothing. Mixer-view level/pan and live macro 3/4 turns do work on tracks 1-6.

d0118_hardware_result.user_report: Level and pan locks still do not work. Knob 1 = reverb, knob 2 = delay, knob 3 = level, knob 4 = pan.

d0120_hardware_result.user_report: Level/pan locks work on the poundhard drum tracks, not on the FM tracks. CPU struggles with three or four voices on different tracks.

d0021_hardware_result.user_report: Shift + track auditioning works. Holding a track button and pressing a slot does nothing. The gestures are brittle; user asked for a two-pad mode UI (pad 22 generate, pad 23 commit).

d0022_hardware_result.user_report: It works exactly as intended. Asked: pads 22/23 dim when idle; pad 21 = kit generator (tap: 32 diverse sounds; hold: clear).

d0023_hardware_result.user_report: Kits come out perfect. A single sound stored in commit mode has crackling/stutter baked into the sample; not with kits.

d0025_hardware_result.user_report: Expansions look the same scheme every page (first 3-4 pads always kicks); not visibly built on previous pages.

d0028_hardware_result.user_report: Step sliders pretty good; but a lock reverted on the next empty step, so a panned kick tail went back to centre.

d0029_hardware_result.user_report: Pan locks hold over the tail, but a hard-right lock leaks a transient on the left (Mixer pan does not). Removing a step should remove its locks.

d0210_hardware_result.user_report: Transient on the wrong side persists with 0.2.10 (locks a sixth of a step early).

d0211_hardware_result.user_report: Not fixed: kick locked to level 0 + hard right still audible faintly on the left at its very beginning.

d0300_hardware_result.user_report: Grid FX locks work well except bit crusher (barely audible); row colours must match stock Grid FX.
